qualification.start: must compile and fail at least one behavior assertion; public tests must pass
qualification.gold: overlay reference lib on clean repo, add oracle tests, require analyze and all tests pass
qualification.negative: Each negative must compile and fail behavioral assertions; analyzer diagnostics are recorded separately and do not prove behavioral discrimination.
qualification.coverage: independent public contract coverage review required before sealing

scope_limitations: Pure service/domain tests in Flutter packages; no GUI, device, production storage or real identity-provider qualification.

required: explicit applicable orchestration policy determines whether delegation is required or merely eligible
record delegated task ownership, isolation, independent module work, root integration and verification when delegation occurs
single-agent domain test success cannot establish delegation
